name: Bold Upsell
summary: Shopify upsell app by Bold: AI-picked and manual upsells, cross-sells, order bumps, free gifts and subscription offers on product pages, cart and drawer and after purchase, with checkout offers for Shopify Plus stores and an AOV dashboard.
best_for: Shopify stores on the Basic or Grow plan that want upsells, cross-sells, free gifts and post-purchase offers across product page, cart and thank-you page for a flat monthly fee that does not grow with order volume
skip_if: your store is on Shopify Advanced and the $74.99 price buys nothing a Basic store does not get; you want in-checkout upsells without Shopify Plus; or you cannot risk an app that edits orders and discounts on a live store without a test window longer than seven days
honest_knock: Bold Upsell is priced by your Shopify plan, so a store on Shopify Advanced pays $74.99 a month for exactly the feature list a Basic store gets for $4.99, and checkout offers need Shopify Plus at $399.99 a month. The 7-day trial is short for judging an upsell app. The reviews are mostly warm, but 50 of 594 are one- or two-star, and the recent ones are specific: add-to-cart and checkout rates down 70% after offers went live (January 2026), the app failing at its one job with support silent for days or weeks (edited October 2026), and the app stopping without notice (November 2025). The data access is wide, including viewing sensitive customer data and editing orders and discounts. We have not run the app ourselves; this dossier is read from the listing and its reviews.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-06 on the Shopify App Store listing at apps.shopify.com/product-upsell, prices in USD) Four plans, and you do not choose between them: each is named after a Shopify plan, so the app costs what your store's own Shopify plan dictates. Shopify Basic is $4.99 a month, Shopify Grow $24.99, Shopify Advanced $74.99 and Shopify Plus $399.99. Each carries a 7-day free trial. The feature list is the same on the first three: Smart AI upsell offers, cart page and cart drawer offers, custom cross-sells and 'true' upsells, funnel offers, post-purchase offers, free gift offers, subscription offers and a rewards announcement bar. The Plus plan adds checkout offers, the only feature that appears on one card alone. The listing calls this flat-rate monthly pricing: nothing is metered on orders, views or the revenue the app generates. All charges are billed in USD, and recurring and usage-based charges are billed every 30 days.

compare_with.name: Selleasy
compare_with.why: Selleasy is in our dossiers too, and it prices the opposite way. Read on 19 September 2026, its Shopify listing charges by your store's monthly order count: free up to 50 orders, $9 from 51 to 500, $19 to 1,000 and $29 above that, with a 30-day trial, and the vendor's own page adds a $49 Pro tier that includes checkout upsells for Shopify Plus stores. Bold Upsell ignores order count and follows your Shopify plan: $4.99 on Basic, $74.99 on Advanced, $399.99 on Plus. So a busy store on Shopify Basic is cheaper on Bold ($4.99 against $29), a quieter store on Advanced is cheaper on Selleasy, and a Plus store that wants checkout upsells pays $49 on Selleasy's Pro against $399.99 on Bold. Price both at your own Shopify plan and order count before you choose.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Bold Upsell (in the admin Bold Product Upsell) on a Shopify development store: the install, the Basic test charge approved without a payment method, one Upsell offer made in about 8 minutes and seen only in the preview inside the app (the app embed stayed inactive and other upsell apps were also switched on in the store), the plan shown in the app and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was billed. Install: the install button of the App Store listing was pressed at 14:34 in our own tab; Shopify showed the Install app dialog with View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, and the install was approved. The app opened on a login page and then a plan selection at about 14:35. In the admin the app is called Bold Product Upsell, while the App Store listing says Bold AI Upsell & Cross-Sell. Our development store also had other upsell apps switched on; everything below comes from the Bold app or the Bold install and approval screens. Approval: the plan selection showed one plan, Basic $4.99 /month (Boost your average order value from day one with Bold Upsell), with the button Get Started for Free. This led to a Shopify Approve subscription screen: You will not be billed for this test charge., plan Basic, $4,99 USD every 30 days, You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov., Subtotal $4,99, Total $4,99 Due 24 Nov. An Add payment method row was shown but not required. Because the screen said it was a test charge, we approved it at 14:36; no payment method was entered and nothing was billed. Core action, one upsell offer, about 8 minutes (14:34 to 14:42) after the install and about 12 clicks from Manual Offers: an onboarding Enable the Bold Upsell App Embed in three steps (Configure your theme, Choose your offer type, Configure your offer) was continued without opening the theme editor; then Setting up your Smart Offers and Smart Offers Queued (We're still learning about your store! To give you the best offers, we need a bit more order data.). Under Manual Offers, Create Your First Offer, Choose Offer Type (Cross-sell Buy X Get Y, Upsell, Post-Purchase Thank You Page, Post-Purchase Email, Free Gift, Funnel, Rewards Bar, Bundles and subscription offers), we picked Upsell, then Configure & Style: Offer Name Snowboard upgrade, Location Product Page (Only one location available), Trigger Products All products selected, Offer Products 1 product selected (The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard $2629.95). The preview inside the app, a pop-up, showed Want to upgrade?, Accepting this offer will replace the original item in your cart with the offer below., a button Replace item and a link No thanks, at about 14:41. Create Offer gave Offer created successfully. and the list showed Snowboard upgrade, Upsell, Product Page Pop-up, Views 0, Conversions 0, Revenue $0.00, Active, at about 14:42. The banner said App Embed Status: Inactive, Action required to display upsells on your storefront. Please enable the Bold Upsell App Embed in your theme. We did not switch the embed on, so the offer was NOT seen on the storefront; only the preview inside the app was seen, and no theme change was saved. Plans: the app showed only the Basic plan at $4.99 /month, which agrees with the App Store; the other plans of the listing (Grow, Advanced, Plus) were not shown in the app. Cancelling: no payment was ever due and the trial was not cancelled separately. The app was uninstalled via Settings, Apps, the row Bold Product Upsell and Uninstall; the dialog says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason is required, we gave Testing multiple apps, and at about 14:48 the app was gone from the installed apps. No separate account, demo, call or phone number was asked. Not tested: the storefront display (the app embed was not switched on), offers in the cart or drawer, post-purchase offers, checkout offers for Plus, Smart Offers (no order data yet), the plans Grow, Advanced and Plus, and a real conversion. Clean up: no theme changes were saved; only the offer Snowboard upgrade existed in the app and went away with the uninstall; other apps were not touched; our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The onboarding wants the app embed switched on in the theme before anything shows on the storefront, the Smart Offers need more order data, the app shows only the Basic plan, and other upsell apps were also switched on in the store.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Bold Upsell (in the admin Bold Product Upsell) on a Shopify development store: the install, the Basic test charge approved without a payment method, one Upsell offer made in about 8 minutes and seen only in the preview inside the app (the app embed stayed inactive and other upsell apps were also switched on in the store), the plan shown in the app and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was billed. Install: the install button of the App Store listing was pressed at 14:34 in our own tab; Shopify showed the Install app dialog with View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, and the install was approved. The app opened on a login page and then a plan selection at about 14:35. In the admin the app is called Bold Product Upsell, while the App Store listing says Bold AI Upsell & Cross-Sell. Our development store also had other upsell apps switched on; everything below comes from the Bold app or the Bold install and approval screens. Approval: the plan selection showed one plan, Basic $4.99 /month (Boost your average order value from day one with Bold Upsell), with the button Get Started for Free. This led to a Shopify Approve subscription screen: You will not be billed for this test charge., plan Basic, $4,99 USD every 30 days, You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov., Subtotal $4,99, Total $4,99 Due 24 Nov. An Add payment method row was shown but not required. Because the screen said it was a test charge, we approved it at 14:36; no payment method was entered and nothing was billed. Core action, one upsell offer, about 8 minutes (14:34 to 14:42) after the install and about 12 clicks from Manual Offers: an onboarding Enable the Bold Upsell App Embed in three steps (Configure your theme, Choose your offer type, Configure your offer) was continued without opening the theme editor; then Setting up your Smart Offers and Smart Offers Queued (We're still learning about your store! To give you the best offers, we need a bit more order data.). Under Manual Offers, Create Your First Offer, Choose Offer Type (Cross-sell Buy X Get Y, Upsell, Post-Purchase Thank You Page, Post-Purchase Email, Free Gift, Funnel, Rewards Bar, Bundles and subscription offers), we picked Upsell, then Configure & Style: Offer Name Snowboard upgrade, Location Product Page (Only one location available), Trigger Products All products selected, Offer Products 1 product selected (The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard $2629.95). The preview inside the app, a pop-up, showed Want to upgrade?, Accepting this offer will replace the original item in your cart with the offer below., a button Replace item and a link No thanks, at about 14:41. Create Offer gave Offer created successfully. and the list showed Snowboard upgrade, Upsell, Product Page Pop-up, Views 0, Conversions 0, Revenue $0.00, Active, at about 14:42. The banner said App Embed Status: Inactive, Action required to display upsells on your storefront. Please enable the Bold Upsell App Embed in your theme. We did not switch the embed on, so the offer was NOT seen on the storefront; only the preview inside the app was seen, and no theme change was saved. Plans: the app showed only the Basic plan at $4.99 /month, which agrees with the App Store; the other plans of the listing (Grow, Advanced, Plus) were not shown in the app. Cancelling: no payment was ever due and the trial was not cancelled separately. The app was uninstalled via Settings, Apps, the row Bold Product Upsell and Uninstall; the dialog says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason is required, we gave Testing multiple apps, and at about 14:48 the app was gone from the installed apps. No separate account, demo, call or phone number was asked. Not tested: the storefront display (the app embed was not switched on), offers in the cart or drawer, post-purchase offers, checkout offers for Plus, Smart Offers (no order data yet), the plans Grow, Advanced and Plus, and a real conversion. Clean up: no theme changes were saved; only the offer Snowboard upgrade existed in the app and went away with the uninstall; other apps were not touched; our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The onboarding wants the app embed switched on in the theme before anything shows on the storefront, the Smart Offers need more order data, the app shows only the Basic plan, and other upsell apps were also switched on in the store.
